faq.subheading: Find answers to common questions about our legal services and how we can help you.

items.question: What types of legal cases do you handle?
items.answer: We handle a wide range of legal matters including family law, criminal defense, personal injury, DUI/DWI, and civil litigation. Our experienced attorneys are here to help you with your specific legal needs.

items.question: How do I schedule a consultation?
items.answer: You can schedule a consultation by calling our office directly, filling out the online contact form on our website, or sending us an email. We offer flexible scheduling options to accommodate your needs.

items.question: What should I bring to my first meeting?
items.answer: Please bring any relevant legal documents, contracts, police reports, correspondence, and a list of questions you have. The more information you provide, the better we can evaluate your case.

items.question: How long will my case take?
items.answer: The timeline of a legal case depends on its complexity, court schedules, and willingness of parties to settle. During your initial consultation, we will provide a realistic timeline based on your specific circumstances.

items.question: What are your legal fees?
items.answer: Our fee structure varies depending on the type of case. We offer hourly rates, flat fees for specific services, and contingency fees for personal injury cases. We transparently discuss all costs upfront.

items.question: Do you offer payment plans?
items.answer: Yes, we understand that legal expenses can be unexpected. We offer flexible payment plans and structured options tailored to your financial situation.
